request.user:
Subject: Physics
Question type: integer answer (no options)

Two wheels each marked with a dot on its rim are mounted side by side. When the wheels are at rest, the dots are aligned. One wheel is given a constant angular acceleration of π/2 r a d / s e c^2 and the other is given a constant angular acceleration of π/4 r a d / s e c^2 . The time after which the two dots will be aligned again for the first time (in seconds) is

result.working:
Both wheels start from rest, so θ1 = ½(π/2)t² and θ2 = ½(π/4)t².
The dots are next aligned when the angular displacements differ by 2π (one extra full turn).
θ1 − θ2 = ½(π/2 − π/4)t² = (π/8)t².
Setting (π/8)t² = 2π gives t² = 16, so t = 4 s.
